tear-at-the-edge.sentence: Skip this and a moving background tears at the figure's edge.
tear-at-the-edge.claim: On BLUELINE shot 02, the project's own ink warp run with the infill step skipped drags a copy of the man's head out past his edge (up to 19 px in the 832 px frame, in 21 of the loop's 64 frames at the threshold used); the same warp over LaMa's plate leaves his edge clean to the eye. The claim is on the page; the mechanism is the project's (ink_flames.py: infill 'so the moving layer has no head to smear').
